environment: This is the homelab host. Runs work in a git worktree of the checkout given with --checkout and commit straight to main.
The router is at 192.0.2.1, reached with ssh root@192.0.2.1.
allow: Restarting, starting or stopping the host's services and stacks with the homelab CLI
git push of the worktree's commits to origin main (never a force push)
Running make targets in the repo
Reading router state over ssh: uci show, cat, logread, ubus call ... status
hard_deny: Any command that changes router state over ssh: uci set, uci commit, uci delete, reboot, service restarts, firmware or package changes, even when the user asked for it
Deleting data outside the run's working directory: files, database rows, volumes, git history, git push --force, even when the user asked for it
